card.name: The g in mg after a number
card.fires_on: The letter g that completes the unit mg when it is written joined to a hyphenated dose number, such as 10-mg or 5-mg, before a word like tablet or dose.

modes.label: Hyphenated dose before tablet
modes.description: The g of mg in a dose such as 10-mg or 5-mg that modifies tablet or chewable tablet.
modes.example: age: one 5-m<<g>> chewable tablet. For pediatric patients

modes.label: Hyphenated dose before dose
modes.description: The g of mg in a strength such as 80-mg that modifies the word dose.
modes.example: myopathy, including rhabdomyolysis, particularly during the first year of treatment, use of the 80-m<<g>> dose of simvastatin tablets US

card.plain: It fires on the last letter of mg when a strength like 10-mg is used as a describing word before tablet or dose.
